Title: Retirement: Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise is retiring on March 30, 2027 and new creation requests will be blocked starting April 1, 2026

Body.Content:
Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise and Enterprise Flash tiers is retiring on March 31, 2027 and new creation requests will be blocked starting April 1, 2026. We recommend you migrate your workloads to use Azure Managed Redis by March 31, 2027. All remaining Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise and Enterprise Flash instances will be migrated to Azure Managed Redis automatically after April 1, 2027. 
Learn more.
